# netactuate_bgp_dashboard (Data Source)

Reads a BGP Dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_bgp_dashboard" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `flap_window` (Number) Dashboard flap window filter.
- `group_type` (String) BGP group type filter.

### Read-Only

- `dashboard_json` (String) Compact JSON BGP dashboard payload returned by the API.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
